activation: manual privileged caller only; no service, default config, mount or boot hook
platform_guard_required: caller must pin media identity, filesystem and mount namespace before use; this CLI does not discover or format media
directory: preexisting root:root0700 ext4/tmpfs directory, no symlink components, marker .muos-saves-v1 containing MUOS-R35S-SAVES-V1 LF, regular files root:root0600/nlink1
bootstrap: caller creates marker and directories exclusively, fsyncs marker and parents; init never resets an existing or invalid HEAD
identity: 64 lowercase hex characters derived by caller from a versioned domain and exact content/core identity; never default to another identity
CLI: muos-save-store init|status|recover STORE ID; muos-save-store commit|export STORE ID RAM_DIRECTORY
snapshot: MUOSSAV1 v1 immutable bundle with lengths, identity and CRC32; quicksave.state PKSTv1, states.ini with quicksave group and PNG signature for quicksave.png
input_export: root-owned0700 tmpfs directory; export requires an empty directory; caller must stop/flush native writer and perform semantic validation before commit
publication: exclusive nonblocking flock; exclusive generation file, file fsync, directory fsync, exclusive .head.new, file fsync, rename HEAD, directory fsync
recovery: explicit recover validates PREVIOUS, publishes it as CURRENT, preserves NEXT and all generation files; no automatic fallback, defaults or orphan adoption
failures: unknown/corrupt/stale data refused unchanged; before HEAD rename old HEAD retained and orphan may remain; sync failure after rename returns74 with durability unknown and no automatic rollback

exit_codes.3: absent record/generation/previous; never implies permission to reset
